label: Stop auto-record (d57563b175a) misreads a packet path that ends at a JSON escape in the JSONL transcript: the trailing \n fails the leaf-segment regex, so a phase child resolves to its parent (which has spec.md) and a top-level packet drops out, so the one-packet rule counts wrong and answers can be written to the parent phase or the only other packet named. Reproduced on the compiled detectSpecFolder.

Stop auto-record (d57563b175a) does an unlocked read-modify-rename of decision-record.md and then appends consumed keys; a concurrent save or second session on the same packet can drop one writer rows while both mark their keys consumed, so lost answers are never offered again. Inferred from code, not reproduced.

When the consumed-key append fails after a successful record write (d57563b175a), the answers stay pending and the next Stop replaces the existing row with Recorded automatically text, wiping a reason a person added; no duplicate row, but the nudge keeps asking.
Live decision-record.md in this packet holds Q001-Q007 auto-recorded rows with no duplicates.

direction: duplicate rows when the consumed write fails
